best_idea: a two-roll hit test (attack draw against defence draw, each bounded by a level-times-bonus roll) where the damage ceiling comes from a separate strength roll, so the hit chance and the damage ceiling are tuned by different stats.
decision_why: the roll-against-roll hit and the stat-derived max hit are simple, checkable and server-friendly, so they fit one engine and server-verified kills; adapt because the donor's 8-tick locks, attack delays and one-attacker lock do not fit fast duels or MAX_ATTACKERS = 3.
acceptance: server test with a seeded RNG: 100,000 swings at attack roll 4544 and defence roll 4352 hit about 52.1 percent, no hit exceeds the computed max hit, and a target at 0 hp takes 0 damage; the client shows a block on a miss and a number up to the max hit on a hit.
